reason: The accepted status diagnostic has only one BMSR sample with link-status=false and autoneg-complete=false. Linux v6.12 genphy_update_link treats BMSR link status as latched low and reads BMSR again before classifying link/autoneg state, so the next objective discriminator is a read-only BMSR double-sample proof.

future_candidate_contract.operation_boundary: read-only corrected-target Clause 22 MDIO MAN reads

selected_reads.purpose: reject BMCR_ANRESTART/reset/loopback blockers and retain BMCR_ANENABLE context
clear or expose latched-low link status
classify link/autoneg readiness from BMSR_LSTATUS and BMSR_ANEGCOMPLETE

future_candidate_contract.paired_control: same reporting path, no MDIO target construction, no MAN frame construction, no volatile MDIO load/store

rejected_claims: MACB NSR_LINK as the selected discriminator
retained_risks: A read-only BMSR double-sample can prove only PHY1 link/autoneg register readiness or not-readiness at the selected instant.
Even a link-ready BMSR result would not prove MAC configuration, DMA/descriptors, interrupts, packet I/O, networking, sockets, SSH, or Phase 12.2 readiness.
GPIO32/PHY reset ownership and PHY configuration writes remain separate unaccepted frontiers.

next_action.required_planning: Supervisor must add an explicit queued proof task before implementation/hardware; this source contract does not create or authorize that task by itself.
